description: A man with long dark curly hair in a brown embroidered vest and white lace-collared shirt leans over a marble counter, serving a small glass dish of pale iced cream. A wooden tub of ice with a scoop sits at lower left. Behind him, candlelit tables hold seated figures: a man in a grey powdered wig and a woman in a red-brown gown with a feathered hair ornament. Mirrors, wall sconces and wine glasses fill the dim room. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
